title: A day at Isha Foundation 🕉️✨
subtitle: @explorewithakashdubey
caption:
A day at Isha Foundation 🕉️✨

Planning a visit to Isha Foundation, Coimbatore? Here’s everything you shouldn’t miss 👇

🕉️ Adiyogi Shiva Statue – The iconic 112-ft statue and the heart of the campus.
🧘 Dhyanalinga – A powerful meditation space where complete silence is maintained.
💧 Theerthakunds – Sacred water bodies believed to prepare you before entering Dhyanalinga. (Carry an extra set of clothes)
🌿 Explore the Campus – Take your time, soak in the peaceful atmosphere and don’t miss the sunset with Adiyogi in the background.
✨ Light & Sound Show – End your visit with the beautiful show at Adiyogi. Timings may vary, so check before visiting.

⏰ Timings
• Campus: 6 AM – 8 PM
• Dhyanalinga: 6 AM – 8 PM
• Light & Sound Show: Usually around 7 PM

🎟️ Entry to the campus & Adiyogi is free.

title: Three days at Isha and something within us softens,s...
subtitle: @padmasoorya
caption:
Three days at Isha and something within us softens,slow down and gently opened.

From standing in awe before Adiyogi, taking sacred dips in Sooryakund and Chandrakund, seeking blessings at the Bhairavi temple, to sitting in deep stillness at the Dhyanalinga every moment felt held in grace. 

Mornings began with laughter, frisbee, throw ball and pure child like joy. We walked through the Goshala, became part of Save Soil movement, danced, meditated, laughed and let joy flow freely without effort.

But the deepest imprint was left by the people. From swamis to volunteers, from security to every smiling face, grace flowed effortlessly. Gentle, grounded, joyful souls reminding us that spirituality isn’t distant or stern, it’s warm, playful and deeply human.

We left with full hearts, quieter minds and one simple thought, This is just the beginning!

Grateful.Humbled 🙏🏻

@isha.foundation @sadhguru 

#ishafoundation #sadhguru
